title: Showcase Smoke 定时任务 30 次里 16 次失败(三个图表面板拿不到 chart SVG),且诊断产物上传路径写错 —— 每次失败都无法事后定位
body:
## 两个独立缺陷

### 1. 三个图表面板持续失败

[run 30796529117](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/30796529117)(2026-08-03 08:12):

```
3 failed
  [chromium] › e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts:47:7 › surface renders cleanly: Delivery Operations
  [chromium] › e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts:47:7 › surface renders cleanly: Chart Gallery
  [chromium] › e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts:47:7 › surface renders cleanly: Command Center
31 passed (4.9m)
```

断言点是 `showcase-smoke.spec.ts:65`:

```js
const box = await svg.boundingBox();
expect(box, `${surface.name}: no chart SVG`).not.toBeNull();
// >0 alone previously passed even on a collapsed ~130px-wide chart panel
```

失败的三个全是带图表的面板,其余 31 项通过。定时运行的历史:**30 次里 16 次失败**,最近连续两天(08-02、08-03)都红,而 07-30 / 07-31 / 08-01 是绿的 —— 时红时绿,不是一次性环境问题。到底是渲染回归还是探测条件不稳,需要看 trace 才能判断,而这正好被第 2 个缺陷挡住了。

### 2. 诊断产物从未上传

```
##[warning]No files were found with the provided path: examples/app-showcase/playwright-report/.
          No artifacts will be uploaded.
```

上传步骤配的是 `examples/app-showcase/playwright-report/`,而 Playwright 实际把截图、trace、error-context 写在 `test-results/` 下:

```
test-results/showcase-smoke-surface-renders-cleanly-Command-Center-chromium-retry1/test-failed-1.png
test-results/showcase-smoke-surface-renders-cleanly-Command-Center-chromium-retry1/trace.zip
test-results/showcase-smoke-surface-renders-cleanly-Command-Center-chromium-retry1/error-context.md
```

`if-no-files-found: warn` 让这个错配只是一条 warning,于是**每一次失败的证据都在 runner 回收时丢掉了**。这也解释了为什么一个半数失败的探针能长期无人处理 —— 想查也查不了。

第 2 条应当先修:它是第 1 条的**前提**。修好之后下一次夜跑就会留下 trace,届时才谈得上判断图表面板到底怎么了。

## 建议

- 上传路径改为同时覆盖 `playwright-report/` 与 `test-results/`(或改成 Playwright 配置里实际的 `outputDir`);
- `if-no-files-found` 在**测试失败**的前提下应为 `error` —— 失败却没有产物本身就是一个应当报警的状态,而不是 warning。
